description: Updates ONE alarm of a WinCC Unified HMI: only the fields passed change (none passed: 400 missing_param). The rules of a create apply to what it changes and to what those changes interact with; the references it carries unchanged are not re-audited: tia_hmi_validate finds dangling ones. alarmClass and triggerTag must exist, else 409 reference_not_found. A discrete alarm raises on a bit of the trigger tag: triggerBit (required on create) and triggerMode; a tag that is not bit-addressable is 409 tag_type_mismatch, a bit past the width 409 trigger_bit_out_of_range (details.tag, dataType, bit, max). An analog alarm compares a numeric trigger tag with ONE conditionValue (there is no second limit) under a condition; the value must fit the tag's data type, else 409 tag_type_mismatch or condition_value_out_of_range (also above 2^53 on LInt, ULInt, LWord: TIA stores a double). Whole numbers of 2^53 or more must be strings, and the serve refuses a whole number written as a decimal JSON number such as 5.0 (400 bad_request). A property of the other kind is 400 bad_request, as is an eventText culture that is not an active project language. Refused, nothing changed: 400 invalid_name (details.kind, name, rule) for a blank, over-long or malformed name, 409 name_collision (details.existing) for a used name, 404 not_found, 409 hmi_attribute_unreadable, and 409 hmi_attribute_list_unavailable or hmi_attribute_not_writable only for the Text of the event text item of an eventText culture (an alarm's own attribute list is never read). An update is refused before anything is written, its dryRun included. A failed write restores the previous values. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve: it runs every guard the real write runs and answers {dryRun:true, status:"plan_ok", hmi, ...} with no `postcheck`, changing nothing. A real write answers the re-read values and a `postcheck` {verified:true, requested, actual}; a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches, details.rollback: restored, not_restored or not_attempted): re-read before anything else. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to POST /hmi/{hmi}/alarms/{kind}/{alarm} {name, alarmClass, triggerTag, triggerBit, triggerMode, condition, conditionValue, priority, eventText}. M-off.

alarm.description: alarm name, as listed by tia_hmi_alarms

condition.description: analog alarms only: LowerLimit, UpperLimit, Equal, NotEqual, LowerLimitOrEqual or UpperLimitOrEqual

conditionValue.description: analog alarms only: the value the condition compares the trigger tag with, a number or numeric text that fits the tag's data type; whole numbers of 2^53 or more must be strings (a number that large is refused here, as JavaScript has already rounded it); on an LInt, ULInt or LWord tag the serve refuses a whole number above 2^53 in absolute value (409 condition_value_out_of_range: TIA stores the value as a double) and accepts 2^53 itself; the serve refuses a whole number written as a decimal JSON number such as 5.0 or 1e3 (400 bad_request)

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

eventText.description: event text per language as { "<culture name>": "text" }; every culture must be an active project language (tia_project_languages); plain single-paragraph text without markup (the serve wraps it as the rich text TIA stores and escapes & < >): a blank text, one over 1024 characters, a line break or a character XML cannot hold is 400 bad_request, and a text cannot be cleared; date-looking text is kept as it is

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

kind.description: discrete (raised by a bit of a tag) or analog (raised by comparing a numeric tag with a value)

name.description: new alarm name (rename), with the same rules as a create

priority.description: alarm priority, an integer from 0 to 255 (the serve refuses anything else)

triggerBit.description: discrete alarms only: the bit of the trigger tag that raises the alarm, from 0 to its bit width minus 1

triggerMode.description: discrete alarms only: OnRisingEdge or OnFallingEdge

triggerTag.description: name of the tag that triggers the alarm (from tia_hmi_tags)

name: tia_hmi_alarm_update
title: TIA — update HMI Unified alarm
